name: audio-player
title: Audio player bar
description: Playback bar with play toggle, meta, and a token-styled progress track.

contract: data-uifa-slot="play" click toggles playback; the aria-label flips play/pause
aria-valuenow 0-100 on the role=progressbar drives data-uifa-slot="progress-fill" width

docs: Reader-style player bar. The play control announces Play/Pause via `aria-label`; position lives on the `[data-uifa-slot="progress"]` element (`role="progressbar"` with value attributes) and its fill width mirrors `aria-valuenow`. The example script simulates playback; point the same hooks at a real `<audio>` element to consume it.
